title: Camp David RV Resort

services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Camp David RV Resort has 50 RV sites (both back in and pull thru). We are ecstatic to now host greater numbers of wonderful campers and guests! Our campground offers full hookups (water, sewer, & electric) for 30 and 50 amp campers. Our office is open and our bathhouse now has 4 restrooms and showers available as well as a laundry room. We do have full water, sewer, and electric at EVERY site. These will also be included in your reservation and invoice. Please understand that by making a reservation with the campground, you are agreeing to these Rules and Regulations. Thanks for your support and cooperation!
